title: Protect secrets reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for protect secrets should include: secrets., env:, permissions:.
answer.example:
name: Send a credential only to its consumer
on: workflow_dispatch
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  call-api:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Call the configured test endpoint
        env:
          API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.API_TOKEN }}
          API_URL: ${{ vars.API_URL }}
        run: curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 10 -H "Authorization:Bearer $API_TOKEN" "$API_URL"
answer.verification: The credential is available only to the API step and is not printed. This example requires a trusted manual run and a test endpoint configured in repository/environment settings.
